description: Verbatim, byte-identical input copies of IRE's static recommendation lists (not edited here; the generated route catalogue sits alongside them and never rewrites them). Source of truth: the owner's local InferHub research workspace (not version-controlled). Referenced by docs/INFERHUB-API-SETUP.md 'Top 20 or Top 20+ lists'.

lists.meaning: Top 20 recommendation view by empirical score; gated rows stay visible, recommendation_eligible marks rows allowed into the operational shortlist.

Operational shortlist selected from all eligible candidates (includes eligible models beyond the Top 20 view, e.g. MiMo V2.5). Treated as the 'Top 20+' list; that mapping is an interpretation (unverified).
